import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import transcript


def test_sv4cd01_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(transcript.render([{'seq': 1, 'author': 'a', 'text': 'hi'}, {'seq': 4, 'author': 'b', 'text': 'yo'}, {'seq': 2, 'author': 'a', 'text': 'ok'}]))
    items = e.findall('li')
    assert [i.get('data-seq') for i in items] == ['1', '2', None, '4']
    assert items[2].get('data-missing') == '3-3' and items[2].text == '1 message missing'
    assert items[3].find('b').text == 'b' and items[3].find('b').tail == ' yo'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import transcript


def test_sv4cd01_boundary():
    assert ET.fromstring(transcript.render([])).findall('li') == []
    e = ET.fromstring(transcript.render([{'seq': 1, 'author': '<a>', 'text': '&'}, {'seq': 5, 'author': 'b', 'text': 'z'}]))
    gap = e.findall('li')[1]
    assert gap.get('data-missing') == '2-4' and gap.text == '3 messages missing'
    assert e.findall('li')[0].find('b').text == '<a>'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import presence_bar


def test_sv4cd02_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(presence_bar.render([{'name': 'b', 'last_seen': 0}, {'name': 'a', 'last_seen': 95}, {'name': 'c', 'last_seen': 99}], 100))
    spans = e.findall('span')
    assert [s.text for s in spans] == ['a', 'c', 'b']
    assert [s.get('class') for s in spans] == ['dot online', 'dot online', 'dot idle'] and e.get('aria-label') == '2 of 3 online'
